refuter.evidence: Attack: §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 makes a reference-modified numeric, numeric-edited or alphanumeric-edited item category alphanumeric and an alphabetic one alphabetic; the reader's probes covered only A/X slices. rini1-001 (--std 85): N4 PIC 9(4) (2:2) REPLACING ALPHANUMERIC -> [1QQ4], REPLACING NUMERIC -> unchanged; ZZ99 (P:2) ALPHANUMERIC -> [ QQ2], NUMERIC-EDITED -> unchanged; XBX (1:2) ALPHANUMERIC -> [QQB], ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED -> unchanged; A(4) (2:2) ALPHABETIC -> [AQQD], ALPHANUMERIC -> unchanged; group (2:2) ALPHANUMERIC -> [1QQB], NUMERIC -> unchanged. Same output at --std 2023 (rini1-002). cite.py: OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 ("the categories numeric, numeric edited, and alphanumeric edited are considered class and category alphanumeric"). Category table §1985:IV.4.3.3 and BLANK WHEN ZERO numeric edited (§1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2 text read) agree with the reader's probes.
